name: Algernon Tassin
bio: Algernon Tassin (1869–1931) was an American critic, teacher and writer. He took his degree at Harvard in 1892.
He taught English at Columbia University and wrote on the history of American periodicals, as in The Magazine in America (1916). His few poems were printed in college and magazine verse.

poems.title: Attainment
poems.author: Algernon Tassin
